line_text: It's hard to believe a year has passed so quickly.

trigger: requested by 監視監督.Movie監視
line_text: Rabanastre is finally back to the way it was. Like when my parents were still alive.

trigger: requested by 監視監督.Movie監視
line_text: We've lost so much.

trigger: requested by 監視監督.Movie監視
line_text: But I think it's important to put the past behind us and keep our eyes on the road ahead.

trigger: requested by 監視監督.Movie監視
line_text: Ashe's coronation is next month.

trigger: requested by 監視監督.Movie監視
line_text: She grows farther and farther away from us...

trigger: requested by 監視監督.Movie監視
line_text: but I guess that's how it has to be.

trigger: requested by 監視監督.Movie監視
line_text: She is queen now, after all.

trigger: requested by 監視監督.Movie監視
line_text: I am looking forward to seeing you at the ceremony.

trigger: requested by 監視監督.Movie監視
line_text: You called, my lord?

trigger: requested by 監視監督.Movie監視
line_text: How is Basch?

trigger: requested by 監視監督.Movie監視
line_text: I know he went with you to Archades "to further the cause of peace in Ivalice"...

trigger: requested by 監視監督.Movie監視
line_text: but still, I hope he comes back to Rabanastre, and Ashe, soon.

trigger: requested by 監視監督.Movie監視
line_text: She has to keep up appearances now, so she would never say it...

trigger: requested by 監視監督.Movie監視
line_text: but I think she misses him.

trigger: requested by 監視監督.Movie監視
line_text: Lose Larsa and we lose the Empire.

trigger: requested by 監視監督.Movie監視
line_text: Protect him. I would entrust him to no other's care.

trigger: requested by 監視監督.Movie監視
line_text: I will keep him from harm. I promise you.

trigger: requested by 監視監督.Movie監視
line_text: For the Empire, and for Dalmasca.

trigger: requested by 監視監督.Movie監視
line_text: Your words put me at ease, Brother.

trigger: requested by 監視監督.Movie監視
line_text: Sorry to leave you.

trigger: requested by 監視監督.Movie監視
line_text: (empty string)

trigger: requested by 監視監督.Movie監視
line_text: Oh, I haven't told you the most important part!

trigger: requested by 監視監督.Movie監視
line_text: Vaan and I had been taking care of the Strahl, but it was stolen!

trigger: requested by 監視監督.Movie監視
line_text: We had just finished having her tuned up, too.

trigger: requested by 監視監督.Movie監視
line_text: Actually, stolen might not be the right word. If her owner wants her back, there's not much we can do about it, is there.

trigger: requested by 監視監督.Movie監視
line_text: There's still plenty of time before the coronation, so Vaan's going to pay the two of them a visit.

trigger: requested by 監視監督.Movie監視
line_text: You should see him! He can hardly wait.

trigger: requested by 監視監督.Movie監視
line_text: I'll be going too, of course.

trigger: requested by 監視監督.Movie監視
line_text: Every good sky pirate needs a partner, right?
